title: Elégedett vagyok valamivel: Satisfied With Something

sections.title: A fixed pairing: elégedett + -val/-vel
sections.content: elégedett ("satisfied") always pairs with the -val/-vel ending you already know from cooking and travel — never with any other case. Nagyon elégedett vagyok a szobával. means "I'm very satisfied with the room." Negate it with nem in front of vagyok, the same way as any other adjective sentence: Nem vagyok elégedett a szolgáltatással.

items.english: I'm very satisfied with the room.
I'm not satisfied with the service.

sections.content: Some Hungarian adjectives always pull in one specific case, the way elégedett always pulls in -val/-vel — there's no rule to derive it from, so learn elégedett valamivel as a single chunk rather than elégedett alone.
